translation_en: Muhammad narrated to me: ‘Abd al-Samad narrated to us: My father narrated to us: ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Suhayb narrated to us: Anas ibn Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, said: The Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, came toward Madinah with Abu Bakr riding behind him. Abu Bakr was an older man whom people recognized, while the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, was a young man whom people did not recognize. A man would meet Abu Bakr and ask, ‘Abu Bakr, who is this man in front of you?’ He would say, ‘This man is guiding me along the way.’ A person might think that he meant the road, but he meant the way of goodness. Abu Bakr turned around and saw a horseman who had caught up with them. He said, ‘Messenger of Allah, a horseman has caught up with us.’ The Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, turned and said, ‘O Allah, throw him down.’ The horse threw him down. Then it rose, neighing. The man said, ‘Prophet of Allah, command me to do whatever you wish.’ He said, ‘Stay where you are, and do not let anyone catch up with us.’ The man began the day striving against the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and ended it as his guard. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, stopped beside the lava field. Then he sent for the Ansar. They came to the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, greeted both him and Abu Bakr, and said, ‘Ride on, safe and obeyed.’ The Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and Abu Bakr mounted, while the people surrounded them with weapons. It was announced in Madinah, ‘The Prophet of Allah has come! The Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, has come!’ The people came out to look and said, ‘The Prophet of Allah has come! The Prophet of Allah has come!’ He continued riding until he stopped beside the home of Abu Ayyub. While the Prophet was speaking with his family, ‘Abd Allah ibn Salam heard about him. He was in his family’s date palms, picking dates for them. He hurried, leaving what he had picked with them, and came with it. He heard the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, speak, then returned to his family. The Prophet said, ‘Which of our family’s houses is nearest?’ Abu Ayyub said, ‘Mine, Prophet of Allah. This is my house, and this is my door.’ He said, ‘Go and prepare a place for us to rest at midday.’ He said, ‘Go ahead, both of you, with Allah’s blessing.’ When the Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, arrived, ‘Abd Allah ibn Salam came and said, ‘I bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah and that you have brought the truth. The Jews know that I am their leader and the son of their leader, and the most learned of them and the son of the most learned of them. Call them and ask them about me before they know that I have accepted Islam, for if they know that I have accepted Islam, they will say things about me that are not true.’ The Prophet of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, sent for them, and they came in to him. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said to them, ‘Assembly of Jews, woe to you! Fear Allah. By Allah, besides Whom there is no god, you know that I am truly the Messenger of Allah and that I have brought you the truth, so accept Islam.’ They said, ‘We do not know that.’ The words were repeated three times. He said, ‘Then what sort of man is ‘Abd Allah ibn Salam among you?’ They said, ‘He is our leader and the son of our leader, and the most learned among us and the son of the most learned among us.’ He said, ‘What do you think if he accepts Islam?’ They said, ‘Allah forbid! He would never accept Islam.’ He said again, ‘What do you think if he accepts Islam?’ They said, ‘Allah forbid! He would never accept Islam.’ He said, ‘Ibn Salam, come out to them.’ He came out and said, ‘Assembly of Jews, fear Allah. By Allah, besides Whom there is no god, you know that he is the Messenger of Allah and that he has brought the truth.’ They said, ‘You have lied.’ Then the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, sent them out.
